$comment: Canonical tier-expansion corpus (E52.18 / #2341). The workflow-v2 autonomy tier expansion is encoded in TWO hand-maintained twins that cannot import each other across the backend/cli module wall: expandTier in backend/internal/spec/v2autonomy.go and tierExpansion in cli/internal/spec/migrate.go. This file is the shared proof surface: each module asserts its own implementation against the SAME rows. The claim is CORPUS AGREEMENT, not byte-carrying — the two expansion functions return different types (backend ActionMatrix keyed by class with typed Mode/DelegationCondition; CLI map[string]actionEntry with string fields), so each module projects the corpus through its own type rather than sharing a Go type. Mirrored verbatim into both modules' testdata/ by scripts/sync-schemas; CI's schema-sync gate red-lines any divergence between the three copies. Named *-fixtures.json (NOT *.schema.json) so the docs/spec/*.schema.json sync loop never globs it and never emits its unrecognized-file warning.
